name: Tommy Richards
caption: PFW United States Champion as of January 1999, holding the promotion's most frequently defended secondary title.

tenures.source: the promotion's own recruitment flyer, 23 January 1999

tenures.note: The promotion's own 2001 flyer names him the retired former World Champion who bought and reopened the promotion on 24 January 2001 as its owner and president.

name: Twizted
caption: Won the vacant PFW World Heavyweight Championship in a ten-man steel cage match at Shadowed Light 2001, then lost it eleven days later to Josh Cagle.

identity.note: Shares a ring name with AWMC's own Twizted; no roster, host or document links the two, held distinct under the no-auto-merge rule.

name: "High Risk" Adam King
caption: The youngest of the King brothers, upsetting OZ by count-out at Shadowed Light 2001 with a string of high-risk dives.

identity.note: Shares a name with WMW's own Adam King; no roster, host or document links the two, held distinct under the no-auto-merge rule.

name: OZ
caption: A seven-and-a-half-foot monster who resigned on air at Hardcore Thursday 3/1/2K1 after his own booking was upstaged, demanding a face-to-face with the promotion's owner.

identity.note: An ordinary, widely reused ring name; no roster, host or document links this wrestler to the other held OZ-named records (including GMWE's own Oswald Johnson, aka "Oz"), held distinct under the no-auto-merge rule.

name: Joe Schmoe
caption: A Dogg House division wrestler who upset OZ at Shadowed Light 2001 and, per the promotion's own comedy recap, beat Darkrain the following week for a second straight win.

identity.note: Shares a name with WEWF's own Joe Schmoe; no roster, host or document links the two, held distinct under the no-auto-merge rule.

name: Jonny Nightmare
caption: A five-time former PFW Television Champion who opened Shadowed Light 2001 by losing to Bill Klein.

name: Darkrain
caption: Debuted against Jonny Nightmare at Hardcore Thursday 3/1/2K1 and lost to Joe Schmoe on Bootleg TV three days later.

name: Rage
caption: A Detroit-billed brawler who lost the "Battle Of Fresh Blood" to Ktulu at Shadowed Light 2001 and was laid out by an interfering Rage during a Hardcore Thursday triple threat.

identity.note: An extremely common ring name reused across dozens of held wings, including BEW's own Brian Anderson (aka "Rage"); no roster, host or document links this wrestler to any of them, held distinct under the no-auto-merge rule.

name: High Flyer
caption: The promotion's own Ring Of Fire tournament winner, defeating Ryan Remedy at Shadowed Light 2001 and winning a Hardcore Thursday triple threat over Rage and Rookie.

identity.note: Shares a name with several other held High Flyer records; no roster, host or document links this wrestler to any of them, held distinct under the no-auto-merge rule.

name: Rookie
caption: Chicago-billed, managed by Coach B; beat Brian Stone at Shadowed Light 2001 with a handful of tights and lost a Hardcore Thursday triple threat to High Flyer.

name: Brian Stone
caption: Brooklyn-billed; lost to Rookie at Shadowed Light 2001, was on the losing side of a Hardcore Thursday tag match, and beat Obi-Wan Jabroni on Bootleg TV.

name: "Hotshot" Bill Klein
caption: Miami-billed; opened Shadowed Light 2001 with a win over Jonny Nightmare and entered the round-robin tournament for the PFW North American Championship.

name: Myke ICON
caption: A former PFW owner and World Champion, ambushing Dante Madison at Shadowed Light 2001 and beating Bill Klein at Hardcore Thursday with the promotion's own owner counting a fast three.

name: "Odyssey" Dante Madison
caption: A debuting rookie who beat Myke ICON at Shadowed Light 2001 after the referee walked out, then beat Brian Stone at Hardcore Thursday.

identity.note: The RSPWF Top 200's own "The Odyssey" Dante Madison carries no PFW tag (only GWC/MPW/MVW/CWF); held distinct under the no-auto-merge rule, reopenable if a shared tag surfaces.

name: "Canadian ICON" Brad Brown
caption: Lost to Twizted at Shadowed Light 2001 and fought Adam King to a double disqualification at Hardcore Thursday.

name: Myst
caption: One half of the Unholy Alliance; won by referee stoppage over an incapacitated Greg Allocca at Shadowed Light 2001 and was billed for the North American Championship round robin.

identity.note: Shares a name with several other held Myst records; no roster, host or document links this wrestler to any of them, held distinct under the no-auto-merge rule.

name: The Anarchist
caption: A PFW legend, losing to Freddy Allocca at Shadowed Light 2001 and teaming with Brian Stone to beat the Allocca brothers at Hardcore Thursday.

identity.note: XUW's own Hodgo carries "The Anarchist" as an aka; no roster, host or document links the two, held distinct under the no-auto-merge rule.

name: Richie Latwaitis
caption: A Dogg House division wrestler pinned by Big Poppa Smurf in a three-way on Bootleg TV.

name: The Krock
caption: A returning wrestler and former Dogg House co-champion, introducing Markus King as Josh Cagle's mystery opponent at Shadowed Light 2001 before being pinned by Big Poppa Smurf on Bootleg TV.

name: "Big" Poppa Smurf
caption: A Dogg House division wrestler, pinning both Richie Latwaitis and The Krock in a three-way on Bootleg TV.

name: Obi-Wan Jabroni
caption: A Dogg House division wrestler, lost to Brian Stone on Bootleg TV.

name: Ktulu
caption: "The Angel Of Death," beating Rage in the "Battle Of Fresh Blood" at Shadowed Light 2001 and attacking Josh Cagle backstage at Hardcore Thursday.

identity.note: Shares a name with several other held Ktulu records; no roster, host or document links this wrestler to any of them, held distinct under the no-auto-merge rule.

name: Ryan Remedy
caption: Lost to High Flyer in a quick opening-card match at Shadowed Light 2001.
